description_en: Retrieves the debugging information for large language model Q&A
name: TongyiChatDebugInfo

parameters.help_en: The key of the workspace. If you do not specify this parameter, the default workspace is accessed. You can obtain the key value from the Business Management page of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不传时访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the response message for the current session
parameters.name: message_id

AnswerInfo.description_en: The answer information corresponding to the conversation

AnswerReferenceInfo.description_en: The referenced knowledge information of the matched answer
AnswerReferenceInfo.description_zh: 命中答案的引用知识信息

ItemList.description_en: The list of referenced knowledge entries

ContentType.description_en: The type of the referenced text

DataSource.description_en: The source of the referenced knowledge

Id.description_en: The ID of the referenced knowledge

Number.description_en: The number that corresponds one-to-one with the ReferNumber in AnswerInfo.MessageBody.DirectMessageBody.SentenceList

ReferenceExt.description_en: The extension information specific to the knowledge type
ReferenceExt.description_zh: 知识类型专属拓展信息

Title.description_en: The title of the referenced knowledge
Title.example: Is it possible to make the payment when the contract entity and the paying entity are different?

Commands.description_en: The command parameters, such as the skill group for the transfer-to-agent command
Commands.description_zh: 指令参数，如转人工指令的转人工技能组

DirectMessageBody.description_en: The message body that contains the Q&A results, including the answer, text type, recommended questions, and matched system type
DirectMessageBody.description_zh: 包含问答结果（答案、文本类型、推荐问、命中系统类型）的消息体

RtDetail.description_en: The response time (RT) debugging information for the current Q&A

SentenceRtList.description_en: The list of RTs for each segment from the time the user question is received on the text side to the sequential generation of the formal answer
SentenceRtList.description_zh: 从文本侧收到用户问题开始，到依次生成正式答案过程中，每一段的RT列表

TransitionRtList.description_en: The list of RTs for each segment from the time the user question is received on the text side to the sequential generation of the transition phrases
TransitionRtList.description_zh: 从文本侧收到用户问题开始，到依次生成承接语过程中，每一段的 RT 列表

ReferNumber.description_en: The number that corresponds one-to-one with the Number in AnswerReferenceInfo.ItemList for generating this answer
ReferNumber.description_zh: 生成本条答案，在AnswerReferenceInfo.ItemList中，对应的Number，一一对应

MessageId.description_en: The ID of the response message for the current session

Pipeline.description_en: The information about the entire Q&A process

items.description_en: The information about the entire Q&A process

Input.example: 用户问句：转人工\n命中规则：[转]人工[客服|服务|坐席]

Name.description_en:
The policy name. Valid values:
High-frequency Q&A direct output
Keyword-based transfer to agent
Global sensitive words

This field is available only when NodeType is system_strategy
Name.description_zh:
策略名称：
高频问答直出
关键词转人工
全局敏感词

当NodeType为system_strategy时，才会有本字段

NodeType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:
system_strategy: system policy.
rewrite_query: retrieved question.
invoke_llm: LLM invocation.
invoke_tools: tool calling
NodeType.description_zh:
节点类型，返回值：
system_strategy：系统策略。
rewrite_query：检索问句。
invoke_llm：LLM调用。
invoke_tools：工具调用

SessionId.description_en: The ID of the session to which the current response message belongs
SessionId.description_zh: 本条应答消息所属会话的 ID
